note: Bighorn NF campground 1.6 miles north of US-14A (Medicine Wheel Passage) on FR 13, about 33 miles east of Lovell, near the Jaws Trailhead and the Medicine Wheel. US-14A climbs from Lovell on a 10% grade; the agency recommends the route via Dayton and Burgess Junction for RVs. Camp host on site. --Claude
summary: FS + rec.gov 250021 read: 15 sites (13 RV 30-100 ft incl. a 100-ft pull-through, 2 tent-only), hand pump, vault toilets, no dump (Burgess Jct 25 mi), reservable with 3 FCFS sites, 14-day, $18.50 (FS says $20) + $10 second vehicle, season 06-12..09-06. Not waterfront kept. Phone empty -> (307) 431-7446.
